description: React component for managing and displaying user property values in the Mattermost admin console, including handling LDAP/SAML links, plugin management, and custom select input for user property options.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds a new option to the user property field options.

methods.name: setFieldOptions
methods.description: Updates the options for the user property field.

methods.name: processQuery
methods.description: Processes the input query to add a new option and reset the query state.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for adding options via Enter or Tab keys.

methods.name: handleOnBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event to add the current query as an option.

methods.name: checkForDuplicates
methods.description: Checks if a new option name already exists among current options.
